note: The only authority that may hold a leg or a registered test receipt at not_run. A receipt may only be printed when the recomputed unavailability codes it names are exactly the codes this file registers, compared in both directions: a code the gate computes but this file does not name, or a code named here that is no longer true, makes the real leg run instead. Deleting an entry re-runs the leg; a registration can never make a leg permanently not_run. review_by is an expiry: scripts/verify-ci-leg-receipts.js fails once it has passed.

entries.object: runtime candidate authority that matches the shipped dependency graph
entries.basis: scripts/verify-runtime-candidate-sources.js runs scripts/runtime-candidate-binding.js, which refuses any direct @aikdna dependency that is not an exact SemVer registry coordinate and any file: lock package outside the candidate binding. The committed graph declares every @aikdna dependency as a vendored file: coordinate, so the leg's verifier stops on the committed graph before it can reproduce either candidate artifact - the coordinate mismatch alone is necessary but not sufficient. Observed: the direct verifier exits 1 on a clean clone with an empty cache.
entries.trigger: scripts/runtime-candidate-binding.js accepts the committed vendored file: coordinate policy (then the gate runs the leg and it must reproduce both checked candidate artifacts from their pinned clean sources) AND the runtime candidate authority is re-pinned to the shipped graph

entries.object: runtime candidate authority that matches the shipped dependency graph
entries.basis: scripts/verify-runtime-candidate-chain.js runs the same scripts/runtime-candidate-binding.js, so it stops on the committed vendored file: graph for the same reason before it can verify the installed Runtime candidate chain. Observed: the direct verifier exits 1 on a clean clone with an empty cache.
entries.trigger: scripts/runtime-candidate-binding.js accepts the committed vendored file: coordinate policy (then the gate runs the leg and it must verify the installed Runtime candidate chain from an empty cache) AND the runtime candidate authority is re-pinned to the shipped graph

entries.object: the packed release artifact evidence of the committed release coordinate
entries.basis: scripts/release-policy.js only produces release coordinates and pack evidence for a stable canonical SemVer version (STABLE_VERSION_RE). The committed version is a release candidate, so the assertion that packs the tarball and parses its evidence cannot run against the committed graph. Observed: tests/publish-hardening.test.js skips exactly this assertion and prints this receipt.
entries.trigger: the committed version becomes a stable canonical SemVer reissue (then tests/publish-hardening.test.js packs the tarball and parses the evidence for real, and this receipt stops being printed)
